name: BITEZ - Delta-8 + Delta-9 + THCP 2000MG Gummies - Pear Champagne
description: Pop the flavor with our Pear Champagne BITEZ gummies! These double-stacked treats capture the essence of premium champagne gummies with one layer of crisp, juicy pear and another of sparkling champagne sweetness. Infused with a potent mix of Delta-8, Delta-9, and THCP, each gummy boasts 1,000mg per piece for a sophisticated, celebratory experience. With two gummies in each baggy (2,000mg total), toast to bold flavor and long-lasting blissful effects. Your taste buds deserve the VIP treatment!
